mandatory_split_families.purpose: Tests whether candidate can generalize partner-related latent inference to new contexts.
mandatory_split_families.failure_mode_blocked: context memorization and context-partner table lookup

mandatory_split_families.purpose: Tests whether candidate can infer partner latent behavior without stable partner memorization.
Tests combined generalization where both stable partner and stable context keys are unavailable.
mandatory_split_families.failure_mode_blocked: stream-keyed count table over (seed, context_id, partner_id)

mandatory_split_families.purpose: Tests adaptation to preference or latent-state transition not present in training episodes.
mandatory_split_families.failure_mode_blocked: transition table and successor map lookup

mandatory_split_families.purpose: Tests whether later behavior changes when latent social/preference state or feedback transition is counterfactually changed.
mandatory_split_families.failure_mode_blocked: static policy imitation and fixed trajectory replay

mandatory_split_families.purpose: Tests whether active information acquisition is necessary for success.
mandatory_split_families.failure_mode_blocked: passive retrieval, static tables, and decorative query actions

mandatory_split_families.purpose: Tests whether success survives remapping of seed/context/partner/episode IDs while preserving underlying causal/social structure.
mandatory_split_families.failure_mode_blocked: ID leakage and deterministic ordering leakage
